name: s2k_createLoadComb
formula: =LAMBDA(loadCombName,comboType,TEXTJOIN("   ", FALSE, "ComboName=" & CHAR(34) & loadCombName & CHAR(34), "ComboType=" & CHAR(34) & comboType & CHAR(34), ))
comment: Returns one COMBINATION DEFINITIONS record. Fields, separated by three spaces: ComboName="loadCombName", ComboType="comboType". Arguments in order: loadCombName, comboType. The formula has no error branch. Last Update at 2026-11-03.
